authority: D-20260905-P4-016 (R3 of 5-round budget; G/H/I synthesis reports/research_p4_round3/)
evidence_scope: train/valid dev only; NO reserved (J03WQQ) or external (SoccerTrack) reads

model.class: AMRModelV6 (scripts/amr_model_v6.py): SHARED trunk + momentum teacher + predictor + mask token
model.encoder: GraphEncoder shared (the rescue target; decoupled v5 already works)
model.teacher: deepcopy at init, requires_grad_(False), EMA over encoder/band_projections/mode-head-Linear only; tau cosine 0.99->1.0 per-step (F: fast teacher for short schedule)
model.predictor: per-band 2-layer MLP 32->128->32, no norms, student-side, 10x trunk LR (Tian et al. via Track G)
model.mask_token: learned 2-dim, student view only, excluded from EMA (MAE-flavored ghost-player corruption, sizes {2,3})

routing_assignment.rule: student-corrupted -> predictor -> teacher-clean band features, normalized MSE, one-directional (BGRL/data2vec asymmetric; Slepian views NOT symmetrized - recovery is directed)

losses.L_vicvar: VICReg variance hinge on FINAL student z_mode (safety net)
losses.L_koleo: KoLeo uniform spread on normalized student embeddings (DINOv2 subordinate)

calibration.note: v4 init measurements stand for shared parts; new numbers from literature (documented judgment calls)
calibration.W_ROUTE: 1.0 middle between v4b 2.0 and F#3 0.03-0.10 (F range is R4 fallback)
calibration.predictor_lr: 10x trunk (Tian et al. NeurIPS 2021 via Track G)
calibration.tau: cosine 0.99->1.0 (BYOL 0.996 too slow for 80 epochs; EMA-scaling + Track F)

training_protocol.optimizer: Adam lr=1e-3 wd=0 (joint; EM-alternation documented as deferred)
training_protocol.streams: context seed*100000, pair seed*200000, route seed*300000
training_protocol.data: IDSSE dev stand-in, train split only
training_protocol.early_stop: active-triplet fraction == 0.0 for 3 consecutive epochs -> COLLAPSED (pre-registered, saves compute)
training_protocol.schedule: v4b schedule verbatim (warm-start 20 route-free, ramp 20, full after)
training_protocol.teacher_update: EMA after EVERY optimizer step (all three loops)

evaluation_plan.frozen: valid context/intrinsic/translation metrics + t5r5_support_reallocation_v1 eps=0.25 intervention eval, verbatim code paths
evaluation_plan.added_diagnostics: valid z_mode singular top-10 (Jing), mu means per (band,support), active-triplet final, collapse flag
evaluation_plan.success_rule: H1/H2 descriptive; any systematic collapse -> v4 fails, M1存废 goes to user (no further autonomous redesign)
evaluation_plan.R1_decision: H1 pass -> AMR (branch-shaping) established, remaining rounds to N4; mode still collapses -> routing objective broken even protected -> R2 freeze-then-route; ctx anomaly (constructionally impossible) -> implementation bug, fix does not consume a round
evaluation_plan.R3_decision: H1 pass on SHARED trunk -> joint training rescued (strongest possible AMR claim), remaining rounds to ablations (predictor width per G-Gaps, F-range weights) + N4; mode collapse again -> asymmetry insufficient at this scale -> R4 JGCL-style single-geometry loss (Track I P1); context collapse again -> teacher pressure also destructive -> R4 freeze-then-route v6 variant (Track E P1)
